text: Figure 4.1: Abstraction model of the free running counter for this driver Minimum value is 0 Maximum value is 255 The counter is reloaded with 0 when it exceeds the maximum value. That means it has 256 count steps. Due to the quantization of counting, two different cases are possible when compar- ing the content of the counter with the threshold. The comparaison can occur when entering a state of the counter or while exiting from a state, as shown in the picture below
